description: This Java class manages mirror parameters for FDroid, including error caching, retry logic, and location determination based on telephony and locale data.

classes.name: FDroidMirrorParameterManager
classes.description: Implements mirror parameter management, error tracking, and location retrieval for FDroid.

methods.name: FDroidMirrorParameterManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing error cache from preferences and setting up delayed write runnable.

methods.name: updateErrorCacheAndPrefs
methods.description: Updates error count for a mirror URL and schedules preferences update.

methods.name: incrementMirrorErrorCount
methods.description: Increments error count for a given mirror URL.

methods.name: getMirrorErrorCount
methods.description: Retrieves current error count for a mirror URL.

methods.name: shouldRetryRequest
methods.description: Determines if a mirror request should be retried based on DNS cache.

methods.name: preferForeignMirrors
methods.description: Checks user preferences for foreign mirror preference.

methods.name: getCurrentLocation
methods.description: Determines current location based on telephony info or locale.
